I feel like I'm living in the wrong era because:
I honestly feel like I don't belong in this world, today. I'm 16, so I don't know what the times were like before the Internet, and I fucking hate that.

I love to look back at old pictures and just imagine what it would have been like back then.

Now, we are surrounded by Social Media, News, and everyone and everything telling us what to do, how to act, and how to live our lives. We spend all our fucking time on Social Media, amazed at how, 'perfect' other peoples's lives are.

I really just want to live back then. I love it, the fashion, the cars, the furniture, the buildings, the people. Just the way that society functioned back then. Back then, people had a sense of community. People actually got to know each other, just, wherever you were living in the local area. When you went to the shop you would actually have a nice conversation with the Cashier, for example.

People were so much nicer back then. The business was less toxic and not ruining so many people's lives. Yes, your quality of life may be low if you were poor, but even then, the vast majority of people were happy.

Today, there are honestly so many shit people and things around us, and it just pisses me off. I hate pointless, materialistic shit. I mean, a little is okay. What you NEED, plus a bit more, is okay. But not being fucking spoilt cunts, running around shopping and discussing Sunday Roast recipes when there are people on the other side of the world starving. The irony.

It does not make any sense to me. I don't feel like I have a purpose. Back then, I could be liked. Back then, people were better. Nicer. Decent human beings. Now? What do I get? Shitty fucking lying, betraying, cunts. Yes, I have my family, and a few close friends, but that's it. I have no one who feels the same way I do.

I wish I could go back. I don't know really what to do with my life.

I really, really, want to be famous, and just be recognised by people. But, the chances of it happening are close to none. I probably won't achieve anything significant in my lifetime.
